name: Princess Ultima ~Chijo to Noroi no Yubiwa~
original_name: プリンセス・ウルティマ～痴女と呪いの指輪～
source:
"People are toys"

That's the belief of Devine's first princess Ultima. Politics and national affairs don't interest her, she enjoys raping and humiliating beautiful women. With her servant Richard and her maid Lucy she searches Devine's capital city for girls to satisfy her sexual desires but something darker is happening around them. Virtuous women are giving themselves to many men at once then losing their memories ...
translation:
“人就是玩具”

这是迪瓦恩的第一任公主Ultima的信念。她对政治和国家事务不感兴趣，她喜欢强奸和羞辱美女。她与仆人理查德和女仆露西一起在迪瓦恩的首都寻找女孩来满足她的性欲，但他们周围正在发生一些黑暗的事情。贤惠的女人一下子把自己奉献给了很多男人，然后就失去了记忆……
